title: Lieutenant Reed
description: Lieutenant Reed was an X-wing pilot for the New Republic. He was on patrol with Captain Carson Teva above Tatooine when The Mandalorian, Din Djarin, did a flyby near a commercial ship. Reed and Teva approached Djarin's vessel and began to ask questions. After Teva recognized Djarin's voice, Djarin sped away. Teva told Reed to forget that it happened.
